title: PrismCrawl Walmart API input
description: Search Walmart products, get product details and seller offers, and collect product reviews through the PrismCrawl API as structured JSON. You need a PrismCrawl API key; each successful request uses one PrismCrawl credit, and failed requests are free.

prismcrawlApiKey.title: PrismCrawl API key
prismcrawlApiKey.description: Your PrismCrawl API key, sent to PrismCrawl as the x-api-key header. Create or rotate it in the PrismCrawl dashboard; new accounts get 100 free credits. The key is stored encrypted by Apify and is never logged or written to the dataset.

mode.title: What to fetch
mode.description: Choose what to fetch. Search uses Search query; the others use Product ID.

query.title: Search query
query.description: For search: text to search Walmart for.

cat_id.title: Category path
cat_id.description: For search (US only): an underscore-separated Walmart category path. Can replace the query.

sort.title: Search sort
sort.description: For search: result order. Walmart Mexico supports price and best match only.

id.title: Product ID
id.description: For details, sellers, and reviews: the product ID from search results.

store_id.title: Store ID
store_id.description: Walmart store for local availability and pricing. Required for seller offers.

rating.title: Star rating
rating.description: For reviews: only return reviews with this rating (1–5).

reviewSort.title: Review sort
reviewSort.description: For reviews: the order to return them in.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: How many pages to fetch (search and reviews only). The Actor stops early when PrismCrawl reports there is no next page. Each page is a separate PrismCrawl request and uses one credit.

walmart_domain.title: Marketplace
walmart_domain.description: For search: Walmart US or Walmart Mexico. Defaults to walmart.com.

device.title: Device
device.description: Device presentation used for the source request. Leave empty for the default.

zero_trace.title: Zero trace
zero_trace.description: When enabled, PrismCrawl does not store the source or parsed response for these requests; only audit and billing metadata is kept. Results still appear in this Actor's dataset.
